name: The Central Archive
description: The main repository of THE UNKNOWN. Rows of climate-controlled shelves, reading rooms, and the Chronology Wing where the first anomalies were recorded.

name: The Forgotten Library
description: A wing that appears on older floor plans but is rarely mentioned in current guides. The Restricted Correspondence Room is located here.

name: The Silent Observatory
description: An abandoned observation post on the edge of the archive grounds. Equipment was powered down decades ago, yet some instruments still register faint readings.

name: The Old Research Station
description: A concrete annex once used for material analysis. Most laboratories were stripped; a few sealed cabinets remain.

name: The Hidden Laboratory
description: Accessible only after specific evidence combinations are recognized. Contains instruments and notes related to the more advanced anomalies.

name: The Underground Records
description: Sub-level storage not shown on public maps. Temperature and humidity controlled. Home of the sealed catalogue gaps.
